run_interactive_demo: run the interactive audio navigation demo with keyboard controls w,a,d,f using pygame
run_following_keys: run the audio navigation demo replaying a sequence of keys from command line argument
draw_top_down_map: draw a top-down map with agent position and rotation from habitat simulation info
run_main_entry: run the main entry point with argparse config for train or eval mode and exp config path
create_audio_nav_env: create an AudioNavRLEnv with a dataset and config for sound-space audio navigation tasks
